observations.broad_market_context: Reuters reported weaker dollar, lower yields and a relief rally after the US midterm election result.

limitations: No direct XRP causal relationship is established.

competing_scenarios.description: The conflict remains unresolved; oil recovered from its prior-session drop and shipping/inventory risks remain. Analyst estimates cited by Reuters included renewed strikes, a deal and prolonged standoff as distinct possibilities.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Positive funding, rising aggregate open interest and a 76.3% long-account share may indicate momentum participation but also crowded-long liquidation risk.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Sustained spot-led buying across independent venues
Falling funding while price and OI remain supported
Long-account concentration declining without price weakness

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: The reported two-day negative holdings delta may reflect fund-level changes, timing, exclusions or non-creation/redemption effects rather than net institutional cash outflow.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Issuer/AP cash creation and redemption records
Custodian-confirmed XRP movements matched to fund share creations

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: USDC and RLUSD network growth, custody and payment infrastructure can expand XRPL utility without creating proportional XRP bridge demand.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Verified XRP bridge volume, XRP inventory requirements, corridor-level XRP turnover and institutional XRP collateral balances

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Different amendment dashboards may report different trusted-validator sets or node views rather than a single universal count.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Same-ledger, same-UNL validator-vote captures from multiple independent XRPL nodes

reasons: No byte-complete raw response captures or SHA-256 receipts were retained for the rendered web observations.
The spot, derivatives and ETF observations are not synchronized to one common source cutoff.
Depth beyond top-of-book and cross-venue sequence-verified order books are missing.
ETF observations are holdings-derived and the latest row is provisional.
Stablecoin/custody adoption is not a direct measure of XRP bridge demand.
The current dataset and out-of-sample evaluation do not establish predictive lift over required baselines.
